You've heard of blind dates with a book - but what about blind SPEED-dating with a book? @wandering.pages.books hosted an event recently where visitors got to know 16 books before picking their perfect match. Hit the link in my bio for my thoughts! #booktok #blinddatewithabook #smallbusiness

The latest installment of SIR SHERLOCK, The Sickle and the Sea, is out now! Hit the link in my bio to check out my thoughts on the new audio (starring Tom Baker and John Leeson) and its novelization. #booktok #sherlockholmes #tombaker #johnleeson #audiodrama #mystery

Any fans of classic #DoctorWho out here? The Doctor Who Appreciation Society has just released a new hardcover on the #ThirdDoctor and #FourthDoctor eras, and I've got a feature in it! Hit the link in my bio to find out more and get your own copy.
